name: Proxmox_VE_BackupCoverage
description: Guests in a Proxmox VE cluster that no backup job covers, answered cluster-wide in a single API call.
technicalNotes:
Single call to /cluster/backup-info/not-backed-up, which answers for the whole cluster regardless of guest count. Requires Sys.Audit on / and filters per guest by VM.Audit on /vms/{vmid}, so an under-privileged token under-reports rather than erroring.

The endpoint is absent on older Proxmox versions. That case reports BackupInfoAvailable=0 and withholds the counts, rather than reporting zero uncovered guests: a zero here is a confident claim that everything is protected, which is the most damaging wrong answer this module could give.

Ships without thresholds. Uncovered guests are often deliberate -- scratch, dev and rebuildable guests are commonly excluded on purpose -- so the alerting threshold belongs to the site's backup policy. Set > 0 where every guest is genuinely expected to be covered.

The uncovered guests are named on stderr, so the collection task log identifies which guests rather than only how many.

datapoints.name: BackupInfoAvailable
datapoints.description: 1 when this Proxmox version exposes backup coverage information. When 0, the remaining datapoints are withheld rather than reported as zero.
